name: Fire Emblem: Life of Seiros
storyline:
Nemesis, once a mere bandit in northern Fódlan, has pillaged the tomb of the Goddess of the Nabateans, and now, imbued with near endless power, marches on Zanado, where the last survivors of this ancient civilization hold a last stand. In the midst of the slaughter, the Goddess’s youngest daughter attempts to use this havoc to flee and is thrust into an alien, unforgiving world, where she must cling on and avenge the slaughter of her people.

The romhack tells the story of two lords, Rhea and Wilhelm, in the lead-up to the War of Heroes, the ancient conflict in the backstory of FE Three Houses that led to the rise of the Adrestian Empire and the Church of Seiros.
